newsitem.title: GERMANY: Issing - bad start to fiscal 97, but still time left.
newsitem.headline: Issing - bad start to fiscal 97, but still time left.

text.p: Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing said on Thursday that fiscal 1997 had got off to a bad start, but that it was too early to write off Bonn's attempts to rein in 1997 budgets.
"The forecast for fiscal 1997 is not at all good, but the year can't be written off yet," Issing said.
He went on to say that the importance of the latest Ifo research institute figures should not be overstated and that no conclusions regarding domestic growth could be drawn from the March Ifo data.
Talking about the March Ifo figures in relation to whether the 2.5 percent growth forecast could be held, Issing said: "It is important these figures should not be overstated."
Issing was speaking at a news conference following a regular policy-setting council meeting.
